sources.entry: n8n - Open-source workflow automation with AI agent nodes, MCP support, and 400+ integrations. #freemium #opensource

summary.name: n8n
summary.one_liner: n8n is a workflow automation platform that combines visual, no-code building with optional code and AI agent steps.
use_cases: automate employee onboarding across Slack, Jira and Notion
security alert triage and incident response
lead qualification and CRM updates with AI
connecting APIs and AI agents to business tools
summary.what_it_does: The page describes n8n as a platform for building AI agents and workflows using a visual builder, with the option to drop into code when needed. It lists 500+ native integrations, plus connections to any API via HTTP and any agent or coding assistant via MCP. It supports human-in-the-loop approvals, guardrails, evaluations, and viewing agent runs live or from past runs. Deployment can be on-prem or via Docker, with source code on GitHub, or as a hosted version. Governance features include SSO SAML, LDAP, encrypted secret stores, RBAC, version history, audit logs, and log streaming to a SIEM.
notable: Fully on-prem or Docker deployment with source code on GitHub
AI agent steps with human-in-the-loop approvals and run replay
500+ native integrations plus any API via HTTP and MCP
Governance features: SSO SAML, LDAP, RBAC, audit logs, Git-based version control
caveats: Pricing tiers are not stated on the page; the directory listing tags it as freemium
Some enterprise security and governance features are described without detail on availability by plan
